title: Iki entity type (iki/v1)
description: A kind of entity, such as a protein or a compound. Each type gets its own table, with history and per-field provenance.

name.description: The type's name in PascalCase. Elsewhere it is `plugin.Name`.

schema_version.description: Increase it whenever the fields change. Other plugins' dependencies and actions name the versions they work with.

extends.description: A parent type: entities of this type are also entities of the parent, with its fields.

abstract.description: Only subtypes have entities; nobody creates one of this type itself.

hrid.description: Human-readable IDs, such as PRT-000123. Never reused.

prefix.description: 2 to 8 capital letters or digits, starting with a letter.

digits.description: The number is padded with zeros to at least this many digits. Defaults to 6.

identity.description: The fields that make an entity the same as another. They must be required and immutable.

on_duplicate.description: What happens when someone creates an entity with the same identity as an existing one: `reuse` the existing one (the default), `warn` and let them choose, or `allow` a duplicate.

title.description: How an entity is named in lists and links, such as `{{ name or hrid }}`.
